text:
ana: Quick sync 1 docs PRs touching SDK snippets for streaming, pagination cursors, and retry behavior. Need to agree on canonical examples before we merge.
leo: please paste PR IDs. i can review TS/Go.
nana: PRs: #4210 (py streaming -> switch to async iterator), #4215 (ts pagination cursor rename), #4220 (go retry pattern + small helper), #4227 (crosslang harmonize: replace fragment snippets).
triage-bot: Note: Snippet CI runs on python3.10/node16/go1.20. Any failing quick-run will block merge.
morgan: i'm worried about #4210  async iterator change might rely on runtime behavior that's changing in the deploy tomorrow. we should gate it.
rachel: i drafted a tiny canonical set for each language. keeping them minimal so they pass smoke tests. Can we use these as the single source of truth?
sree: paste them here and i'll sanity-check for SDK compatibility.
rachel: Python canonical:
```py
# python streaming (canonical)
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
for event in c.responses.stream(model="open-chat-1", input="Explain infra"):
    if event.type == "token":
        print(event.text, end="")
# pagination cursor
page = c.embeddings.list(dataset_id="dataset-01")
while page:
    for e in page.items:
        handle(e)
    page = page.next_page()
```
rachel: TypeScript canonical:
```ts
// typescript streaming + pagination
const c = new RedwoodClient()
for await (const ev of c.responses.stream({ model: 'open-chat-1', input: 'Explain infra' })) {
  if (ev.type === 'token') process.stdout.write(ev.text)
}
let page = await c.embeddings.list({ datasetId: 'dataset-01' })
while (page) {
  page.items.forEach(handle)
  page = await page.next()
}
```
rachel: Go canonical (compact):
```go
// go streaming + pagination (context-aware)
ctx := context.Background()
c := redwood.NewClient()
stream := c.Responses.Stream(ctx, redwood.StreamParams{Model: "open-chat-1", Input: "Explain infra"})
for stream.Next() {
  ev := stream.Event()
  if ev.Type == "token" { fmt.Print(ev.Text) }
}
page, _ := c.Embeddings.List(ctx, "dataset-01")
for page != nil {
  for _, it := range page.Items { handle(it) }
  page = page.Next()
}
```
morgan: looks good. Go snippet includes ctx which is necessary. For #4220 i'll add a tiny retry helper showing exponential backoff with max 3 retries. Keep it inline and short.
leo: prefer that snippets include a one-line `Compat: SDK >= v0.9.2` comment at the top. avoids confusion.
nana: +1. add a `# compat` or `// compat` line in each snippet.
triage-bot: Reminder: docs linters will run `docs/snippets/smoke/*` during PR. Please add a smoke test in the PRs that reference the canonical snippet path.
sree: Decision suggestion: merge #4215 (TS pagination rename) and #4220 (Go retry doc) after adding compatibility notes and smoke script. Hold #4210 (py async iterator) until post-deploy check because it touches the streaming iterator contract. #4227 should be updated to reference the canonical snippets rather than embedding copies.
morgan: i'll patch #4220 with the backoff helper and a comment `// retry: exp backoff, max 3 attempts` and tiny test.
leo: i'll review #4215 today. if it points to the canonical TS snippet file we can merge.
nana: can someone volunteer to run crosslang smoke after the runtime deploy (2026-03-22T02:00:00Z)? we need one person to confirm streaming behaves as expected.
sree: i'll take post-deploy smoke and report in #docs.
leo: small ask: add a PR checklist item "update release notes if examples change behavior". we've had customers report changes before.
nana: added to checklist.
triage-bot: Deploy window: runtime v1.14 -> v1.15 at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. If your snippet depends on the new streaming contract, add `hold: true` to the PR description.
morgan: will set hold on #4210.
nana: thanks all. i'll update the PR descriptions to include the canonical snippet paths, compat lines, and a smoke script example. closing thread for now, will reopen if post-deploy smoke fails. :white_check_mark:
